name: Ruler Analytics
description: Ruler Analytics is a closed-loop marketing attribution and revenue tracking platform connecting website touchpoints across calls, forms, and live chat to closed CRM deals.
best_for: B2B marketing teams and performance marketing agencies with multi-touch sales cycles and CRM deal pipelines.
features: Closed-loop revenue attribution syncing CRM deal values back to ad channels (Google Ads, Meta)
Multi-touch attribution models: first-click, last-click, linear, time-decay, and position-based
Integrated call tracking, form capture, and live chat tracking on all website visitors
Visitor-level customer journey mapping across multiple sessions and devices
Direct bidirectional integrations with Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, and Zoho CRM
Automated conversion tracking into Google Analytics 4

tiers.name: Small
tiers.notes: Up to 10k monthly visits, from £299 a month; a second price set of £269 appears with the annual toggle (save 10%).

tiers.name: Medium
tiers.notes: Up to 50k visits a month, from £499; £449 with the annual toggle.

tiers.name: Large
tiers.notes: Up to 100k visits a month, from £999; £899 with the annual toggle.

tiers.name: Advanced
tiers.notes: From 100k visits a month, from £1,499; £1,349 with the annual toggle. The page calls all prices indicative, scaled to traffic volume and product, data and integration requirements.

pros: True closed-won revenue attribution rather than superficial lead volume metrics
Direct bi-directional sync connecting website visitor click paths to CRM pipeline stages
Supports sophisticated multi-touch attribution models for long B2B buying cycles
cons: Prices start at £299 a month and rise with monthly visits, which is a higher floor than basic call tracking tools
Requires active CRM pipeline integration to unlock full closed-loop attribution power
The page lists no free trial; each plan's Get Started button leads to a demo booking page
